opening: I've had a cough that won't go away.
All of this has been going on for the past 2 months.
Four months ago I went on a hiking trip near Phoenix, Arizona.
I take clopamide every day for my blood pressure.

opening.text: I've had a cough that won't go away, and I've been feeling generally unwell. All of this has been going on for the past 2 months. I have high blood pressure and take clopamide every day for it. Four months ago I went on a hiking trip near Phoenix, Arizona.
